data.one_liner: RichTextView renders text with mentions, hashtags, emails, URLs and view‑more support.
data.what_it_does: It parses a string and turns special patterns into tappable widgets. RichTextEditor adds an input field with mention/hashtag suggestions.
use_when: You need inline links or mentions in a read‑only text block
You want a view‑more / view‑less toggle
You need a simple editor with mention/hashtag suggestions
avoid_when: You need complex custom parsing beyond the provided parsers
You require full‑blown rich text editing with formatting controls
strengths: Supports many common patterns out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to predefined parsers, custom parsing requires extending ParserType
No support for advanced formatting (e.g., tables)
data.minimal_example:
RichTextView(
  text: "Hello @user #tag https://example.com",
  supportedTypes: [
    MentionParser(onTap: (m) => print(m.value)),
    HashTagParser(onTap: (h) => print(h.value)),
    UrlParser(onTap: (u) => print(u.value)),
  ],
  linkStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.blue),
  maxLines: 3,
  truncate: true,
  viewLessText: 'less',
);
